purpose: Category-level research for Power / Grid and adjacent data-centre electrical infrastructure.
categoryRead: Power / Grid remains the highest-quality structural Power Stack category. The latest evidence strengthens the physical-demand side while the bond market strengthens the valuation-risk side: utility T&D, substations, switchgear, transformers, cable and generation remain supported by data-centre and industrial load growth, but 10Y/30Y Treasury yields around 4.7%/5.25% penalise long-duration multiples. Prefer profitable equipment, engineering and regulated-grid exposures with backlog, pricing power and free cash flow over leveraged or narrative-only power names.

regionalRead.US: GE Vernova's Q2 data-centre orders exceeded $5bn YTD, gas equipment backlog/slot reservations reached 116 GW and total backlog reached $176bn. Eaton's Electrical backlog rose 43% YoY. The demand evidence remains exceptionally strong; the key risk is valuation rather than order deterioration.
regionalRead.Europe: AI data-centre projects are moving farther from major cities toward sites with cheaper energy, land and faster grid connections. JLL data cited by Reuters shows 2026-28 hyperscale projects averaging about 175 km from urban centres versus 46 km in 2022-25. Power availability and interconnection speed are increasingly determining geography, strengthening the grid/generation thesis beyond US hyperscaler capex alone.
regionalRead.HongKongChina: China kept the 1Y/5Y LPR at 3.00%/3.50%, signalling reliance on fiscal infrastructure execution rather than broad monetary reflation. Keep emphasis on state-backed power, grid, nuclear and equipment buildout rather than generic domestic cyclicals.
regionalRead.Malaysia: The data-centre buildout continues to translate into real 275kV substation, cable and high-voltage work. TNB remains the lower-beta regulated expression; Southern Cable, MN Holdings and CBH offer higher operating leverage with greater project concentration and working-capital risk.

priorityHierarchy: SCGBHD / MNHLDG / CBHB — Malaysia higher-beta grid-connection layer

candidateRead.CBHB: Maintains 7.9 priority-candidate status after strong earnings/order evidence. No upgrade today because data-centre concentration, short listing history and entry-price risk still require more proof.
candidateRead.ROK: Not a Power/Grid pure play, but warehouse/data-centre automation demand makes it a useful adjacent industrial-capex confirmation.
